layout.body:
Try CALISTAR Free
for Your First 10 Days
Redeem this offer right now：
1.Take this coupon to your doctor and ask whether CALISTAR is right for you.
2. If your doctor prescribes CALlSTAR 5mg or 10mg, present both this coupon and your prescription to your pharmacist.
If you have any questions about CALISTAR, please feel free to call 877-455 9281 or visit CALISTAR.com.
Terms and Conditions: Limit one 10 day free trial certificate per person for the duration of the offer. Valid ONLY at retail pharmacies; no mail order. Do not forget to check patient eligibility restrictions and other terms and conditions on the back of this certificate.
This offer is good until 10/1/06
CALISTAR
Resuscitation calcium
